name: United States
authority: US FDA (Center for Devices and Radiological Health)
regulation: 21 CFR Part 801 (Medical Device Labeling) & Part 830 (UDI System)
udiFormat: GS1-128 / GS1 DataMatrix (01) Primary DI + (17) Expiry + (10) Lot + (21) Serial
specialDirectives: Rx Only statement mandatory on primary container & carton
Sterilization method must match Premarket Notification 510(k) or PMA approval

name: European Union
authority: European Medicines Agency (EMA) / Notified Body (TÜV SÜD 0123)
regulation: EU MDR 2017/745 Annex I, Chapter III (Requirements regarding device information)
udiFormat: Basic UDI-DI + GS1 DataMatrix 2D on all packaging levels
specialDirectives: CE Mark with 4-digit Notified Body number (CE 0123)
Authorized Representative (EC REP) name & address required

name: Japan
authority: PMDA / MHLW (Ministry of Health, Labour and Welfare)
regulation: PMD Act (Act on Securing Quality, Efficacy and Safety of Products)
udiFormat: GS1-128 or GS1 DataMatrix with JAN/EAN compatibility
specialDirectives: Mandatory Kanji caution text: 再滅菌禁止 (Do Not Re-sterilize)
Marketing Authorization Holder (MAH / 製造販売業者) full Japanese address
Japanese Medical Device Approval Number (承認番号) must be prominent
Strict prohibition of mismatched shelf-life notation (YYYY-MM-DD format)

name: Middle East
regulation: SFDA MDS-REQ 1 (Medical Device Requirements) & UAE Medical Device Guidelines
udiDatabase: SFDA Medical Device National Registry (MDNR / DIWAN)
specialDirectives: Bilingual Arabic-English outer carton and Instructions For Use (IFU)
Authorized Local Representative license number and registration barcode
